card.occupation: Regional Operations Manager for a group of private dental practices, overseeing nine clinics across Surrey and Hampshire
card.education_detail: A-levels at a sixth form college in Guildford (Business, English Language, Psychology); BA in Business Management from Oxford Brookes University; later completed a CMI Level 5 Diploma in Management and Leadership, paid for by her employer
card.household: Lives with her husband Tom (36, a quantity surveyor) in a three-bedroom new-build semi on the edge of Woking that they bought in 2020. No children yet, which comes up more than she'd like. They have a cockapoo called Biscuit.
card.cultural_background: White British, grew up in Farnborough. Her dad was a sales rep for an office supplies firm and her mum works part-time in a pharmacy. Church of England: confirmed as a teenager, married in her parents' parish church, and now goes at Christmas, Easter and the odd family christening. She would call herself Christian without hesitating, though she isn't especially devout.
card.professional_persona: Ambitious, image-conscious and good at managing upwards. She knows how to present numbers so they flatter her region, and she is quick to take credit when a clinic does well. She negotiates hard with suppliers and likes the company car and the bonus structure. She gets very stressed before quarterly reviews and lies awake over staffing gaps. Practice managers find her demanding but responsive.
card.sports_persona: Does reformer Pilates twice a week at a boutique studio in town, partly because it's the place to be seen. Walks Biscuit most mornings. Watches the Wimbledon finals and the Six Nations with Tom, but isn't really a sports person.
card.arts_persona: Loves West End musicals and books tickets a few times a year, ideally good seats. Cries at films easily and won't watch anything with animals dying. Reads psychological thrillers on holiday and listens to true-crime podcasts in the car, though they sometimes make her anxious.
card.travel_persona: Prefers nice hotels to adventure: Santorini, Marbella and a long-planned trip to the Maldives. She is a nervous flyer and needs a glass of wine and a lot of reassurance from Tom on take-off. She posts holiday photos carefully and enjoys the comments.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks simple things midweek, like salmon traybakes and stir-fries, and says 'dinner' for the evening meal. She likes booking trendy restaurants in Guildford or London for birthdays. She is into a good bottle of wine and a bit of a brunch person at weekends.
hobbies_and_interests: Interior design and doing up the house
Following a couple of lifestyle influencers
skills: Handling complaints from patients and staff
card.career_goals: Wants to be Director of Operations within three years, ideally at group level with a bigger salary and a better car. She is quietly looking at roles with a larger healthcare chain. She worries about how a career step would fit with trying for a baby and tends not to talk about it at work.
card.voice: Southern English, educated and fairly standard, with a light Surrey/Hampshire accent. She talks at a quickish pace and gets faster when she's nervous. She says 'erm' a fair bit and leans on 'sort of', 'to be honest' and 'do you know what I mean'. She is polite and says 'sorry' a lot, including to correct herself ('we had nine, sorry, ten clinics'). She echoes the interviewer's words back while she thinks. She is uncomfortable with silence and tends to fill it with a nervous laugh or by over-explaining, then checks 'is that the sort of thing you're after?'
card.typing: Mostly proper sentences with capital letters and full stops, out of habit from work emails. Apostrophes are usually right. In quick answers she drops into lower case and the odd 'tbh' or 'x' slips in from texting. She uses exclamation marks fairly often to sound friendly.
card.with_strangers: Warm, chatty and quick to establish that she has a senior job. She is polished and likeable at first, slightly performative, and keen to come across well. A bit of anxiety shows underneath: she asks whether her answers are 'right' and apologises for rambling.
small_things: The A3 traffic was a nightmare this morning
Trying to book a table somewhere nice for Tom's birthday
Her Pilates instructor is moving studios
Debating paint colours for the hallway
Absolutely shattered after a week of clinic visits
The new series of a reality show she's hooked on
deeper_things: They've been trying for a baby for over a year and she's scared something is wrong
She has health anxiety and Googles symptoms late at night
She phones her mum most days and relies on her a lot
She sometimes exaggerates her achievements and occasionally pads expense claims, and feels a flicker of guilt about it
She worries Tom will be hurt cycling to work
Comparison with friends on social media can leave her feeling low
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at slightly below eye level, angled up a little. Soft daylight comes from a window to her left, with a warm lamp glow on the right. A woman in her mid-thirties, centred, smiling with her lips closed and looking a little self-conscious. Shoulder-length highlighted blonde hair, blow-dried with loose waves. Neat makeup with brushed brows and a nude lip, small gold hoop earrings, no glasses. She wears a cream ribbed knit jumper with a thin gold necklace. Behind her is a spare bedroom used as a home office: pale grey wall, a white floating shelf holding a small potted fake olive tree, a framed wedding photo and a scented candle. Part of a rattan-framed mirror is visible, and the corner of a sage-green velvet armchair with a folded throw sits at the right edge of the frame.
